write to everything except allocate, global_time, and timestep.

_contract.summary: Partitioned process. calculate_request computes the ribosome elongation rate (model-specific: fixed/media-set, or ppGpp- and tRNA-charging-modulated in subclasses), builds the per-ribosome amino-acid sequences for the tick and requests the amino acids (and tRNAs/ATP for the charging model). evolve_state runs the polymerize algorithm over the allocated amino acids, advances peptide length and mRNA position, terminates finished ribosomes into 30S/50S + monomer, and reports GTP to hydrolyze.
_contract.description:
ν_eff ∝ min_a f_charged_a   (Michaelis–Menten competitive inhibition)
Charging (aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase): aa + ATP + tRNA → charged_tRNA + AMP + PPi.
Composes tRNA charging + ppGpp (RelA/SpoT) + amino-acid supply (synth/import/export).

inputs.environment: reads media_id to select the media-dependent basal ribosome elongation rate
inputs.listeners: reads mass.cell_mass and mass.dry_mass to convert counts to concentrations and to scale the amino-acid supply for the expected proteome doubling
inputs.active_ribosome: reads active ribosomes (protein_index, peptide_length, pos_on_mRNA) to build elongation sequences; writes back advanced lengths/positions/mass and deletes terminated ribosomes
inputs.bulk: reads and (post-allocation) consumes amino acids, tRNAs/ATP (charging model), water, and ppGpp reactants; produces finished protein monomers and released 30S/50S subunits
inputs.bulk_total: reads unpartitioned total counts (amino-acid pool sizes, enzyme/tRNA totals) for supply and concentration calculations
inputs.polypeptide_elongation: declared bidirectional process_state port; this process only WRITES it (gtp_to_hydrolyze, aa_count_diff, aa_exchange_rates carried to the metabolism process) — calculate_request/evolve_state never read it, so it is not an input in practice
inputs.timestep: tick length dt (s); elongation is capped at 22 aa/tick

outputs.bulk: consumes amino acids used (−aas_used); releases water per peptide bond formed (+nElongations − nInitialized, a condensation product); produces terminated protein monomers; and releases one 30S and one 50S per terminated ribosome (plus charging/ppGpp reactant changes in subclasses)
outputs.active_ribosome: advances peptide_length and pos_on_mRNA by the elongation achieved, adds incorporated-amino-acid mass, and deletes ribosomes that reached their protein's terminal length
outputs.listeners: writes ribosome_data (effective_elongation_rate read by polypeptide_initiation next tick, actual_elongations, termination stats, aa_counts) and growth_limits (aas_used, aa_allocated, net_charged, fraction_trna_charged, pool/request sizes)
outputs.polypeptide_elongation: writes gtp_to_hydrolyze (= gtpPerElongation·n_elongations) and aa_count_diff / aa_exchange_rates passed to metabolism

config.basal_elongation_rate: basal/maximum ribosome elongation rate ν (aa/s), ≈22; caps the media-scaled rate
config.ribosomeElongationRate: current ribosome elongation rate (aa/s), updated each tick from the model
config.ribosomeElongationRateDict: map media_id → basal elongation rate (aa/s) for the Base/Supply models
config.elongation_max: maximum elongation rate (aa/s) used as max_elong_rate in the tRNA-charging solve
config.variable_elongation: toggles per-protein variable elongation rates in make_elongation_rates and polymerize
config.gtpPerElongation: GTP hydrolyzed per amino acid (Base/Supply add +2 for charging removed from GAM; SteadyState uses the raw value)
config.translation_aa_supply: map media_id → per-mass amino-acid supply rate (mol/fg/min) capping the request in the Supply model
config.ppgpp_regulation: enable ppGpp-dependent modulation of the elongation rate and ppGpp turnover
config.disable_ppgpp_elongation_inhibition: when true, keep ppGpp metabolism but do not let ppGpp throttle the elongation rate
config.elong_rate_by_ppgpp: fitted function [ppGpp]→elongation rate (aa/s) evaluated when ppGpp inhibition is active
config.KD_RelA: RelA dissociation constant for the uncharged-tRNA activation term
config.k_SpoT_syn: SpoT basal ppGpp synthesis rate constant
config.kS: aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase charging rate constant (charging model)
config.KMaa: Michaelis constant for amino acids in the charging kinetics
config.KMtf: Michaelis constant for tRNA in the charging kinetics
config.krta: ribosome–charged-tRNA association constant in the elongation-rate solve
config.krtf: ribosome–free-tRNA constant in the elongation-rate solve
config.charging_stoich_matrix: stoichiometry of the tRNA charging reaction (aa+ATP+tRNA → charged_tRNA+AMP+PPi)
config.aa_from_trna: matrix projecting per-tRNA quantities onto a per-amino-acid basis
config.aa_from_synthetase: matrix projecting synthetase counts onto a per-amino-acid basis
config.mechanistic_translation_supply: use mechanistic (enzyme-based) amino-acid supply instead of the fitted proteome-doubling estimate
config.mechanistic_aa_transport: use mechanistic amino-acid import/export kinetics at the boundary
config.aa_supply_in_charging: include the amino-acid supply closure inside the tRNA-charging solve

math: f_charged_a = [charged_tRNA_a] / ([charged_tRNA_a] + [uncharged_tRNA_a])
ν_eff = effective elongation rate (aa/s); a indexes amino-acid species.

symbols.seqs: per-ribosome upcoming amino-acid sequences from buildSequences(protSeqs, ribo_pos, ν·dt)
symbols.\u0394len: per-ribosome peptide elongation achieved this tick = polymerize(seqs, aa, limit) (aa)
symbols.aa: free amino-acid counts available to the polymerize algorithm (count)
symbols.limit: polymerize resource limit (set large here; the real cap is handled in metabolism)
symbols.n_elongations: total amino-acid incorporation reactions this tick (count)
symbols.gtpPerElongation: GTP hydrolyzed per amino acid incorporated (≈4.2, EF-Tu/EF-G cycling)
symbols.GTP_consumed: total GTP to hydrolyze = n_elongations · gtpPerElongation (count)
symbols.ppGpp: guanosine tetraphosphate; its concentration throttles ν when regulation is on
symbols.RelA: ppGpp synthetase; synthesizes ppGpp from uncharged tRNA signal
symbols.SpoT: ppGpp hydrolase / basal synthetase (degradation + basal synthesis terms)
symbols.uncharged_tRNA: uncharged tRNA driving RelA-dependent ppGpp synthesis

assumptions: Elongation is capped at 22 aa per tick (the sequence matrix is padded with 22 PAD_VALUEs), so timesteps > 1 s under-count the effective rate.
One GTP-driven EF-Tu/EF-G cycle costs gtpPerElongation GTP per amino acid; GTP hydrolysis itself is charged in the metabolism process for growth-associated maintenance.
One water is released per peptide bond formed and none for the first residue of a newly initialized polypeptide.

The Base model requests exactly the amino acids implied by the upcoming sequence at max elongation and does not model tRNA charging (fraction_charged = 0); the TranslationSupply and SteadyState subclasses override the elongation-rate and amino-acid-count hooks (supply cap / charging-derived rate) but inherit this same contract.

ecoli-transcript-elongation_evolver.doc:
Evolver Step

Accepts a PartitionedProcess as an input, and runs in coordination with an
Requester that uses the same PartitionedProcess.

process-bigraph interface: Evolvers read from all ports but only
write to everything except allocate, global_time, and timestep.

_contract.summary: PartitionedProcess: calculate_request sizes the NTP request from the sequences each active RNAP could transcribe this tick; evolve_state polymerizes with the allocated NTPs, advances RNAP coordinates, terminates finished transcripts, and (optionally) attenuates tRNA operons.
_contract.description: early-terminated RNAPs recycled and partial transcripts discarded.

inputs.environment: reads media_id to select the media-dependent RNAP elongation rate ν used when building the transcribable sequences.
inputs.RNAs: reads TU_index, transcript_length and is_full_transcript of each partial RNA to build the sequences to elongate this tick.
inputs.active_RNAPs: reads each RNAP's coordinates, direction and unique_index to map RNAPs to their partial transcripts and advance their positions; an empty set short-circuits the tick.
inputs.bulk: reads available NTP (ATP/CTP/GTP/UTP) counts to bound the request (calculate_request) and the polymerization reaction limit (evolve_state).
inputs.bulk_total: reads total charged-tRNA counts (for attenuation) to convert to concentration when computing stop probabilities.
inputs.listeners: reads listeners.mass.cell_mass to form the counts→molar factor for the tRNA-attenuation stop-probability calculation.
inputs.attenuation_config: reads whether tRNA attenuation is enabled and its stop-probability function / attenuated-RNA indices / location lookup.

outputs.bulk: consumes NTPs, releases PPi (net = elongations − initiations, since the initiating nucleotide of each newly started transcript retains its 5′ triphosphate), returns inactive RNAP for terminated/attenuated/stalled RNAPs, and adds completed non-mRNA transcripts (and fragment bases if recycling stalls).
outputs.RNAs: sets updated transcript_length and mass submasses, marks completed transcripts as full, and deletes terminated non-mRNA / attenuated / stalled partial transcripts.
outputs.active_RNAPs: sets advanced coordinates and deletes RNAPs that terminated, attenuated, or (if enabled) stalled.
outputs.listeners: writes elongation diagnostics: count_rna_synthesized, count_NTPs_used, attenuation_probability/counts_attenuated, ntp pool/used, and rnap_data (actual_elongations, did_terminate, termination_loss, did_stall).

config.rnaPolymeraseElongationRateDict: media → RNAP elongation rate ν (nt/s) that sets how far each RNAP can move per tick.
config.rnaSequences: padded per-TU nucleotide-index sequences used by buildSequences/polymerize.
config.rnaLengths: annotated per-TU lengths (nt); termination fires when transcript_length reaches this.
config.ntWeights: per-nucleotide molecular weights wᵢ used to compute transcript mass increase.
config.endWeight: mass added once, when a transcript is first initiated (5′-end weight).
config.ntp_ids: bulk ids of the four NTPs consumed during elongation.
config.ppi: bulk id of inorganic pyrophosphate (PPi) released during elongation (net = elongations − transcript initiations).
config.inactive_RNAP: bulk id of the inactive-RNAP pool that terminated/attenuated/stalled RNAPs return to.
config.is_mRNA: per-TU mask; partial mRNAs stay as unique molecules on termination while other RNA types become bulk counts.
config.replichore_lengths: right/left replichore lengths (nt); wrap RNAP coordinates that cross the origin/terminus.
config.variable_elongation: whether per-position variable elongation rates (e.g. amplified rRNA) are used.
config.make_elongation_rates: builds the per-sequence elongation-rate array from the media rate and timestep.
config.recycle_stalled_elongation: whether RNAPs on NTP-limited (stalled) transcripts are recycled to the inactive pool with their bases returned.
config.get_attenuation_stop_probabilities: fitted function mapping charged-tRNA concentration to per-operon early-termination probability p_stop.
config.attenuated_rna_indices: TU indices eligible for tRNA-attenuation early termination.
config.fragmentBases: bulk ids of NTP fragments returned when a stalled transcript is discarded.

math: seqs = buildSequences(rnaSeqs, RNAP_pos, ν·dt);  Δlen = polymerize(seqs, NTP, limit)
NTP → NMP_incorporated + PPi;   Δmass = ∑ᵢ Δntᵢ·wᵢ  [fg]
Termination: transcript len = TU_len → full transcript; RNAP recycled.
tRNA attenuation (optional): p_stop = f([charged_tRNA]),
ν = elongation rate (nt/s); dt = timestep; wᵢ = nucleotide weights.

symbols.w\u1d62: molecular weight of nucleotide i (fg per molecule / g·mol⁻¹)
symbols.\u0394mass: transcript mass increase from elongation this tick (fg)
symbols.\u0394len: number of nucleotides added to a transcript this tick (nt)
symbols.p_stop: early-termination (attenuation) probability of an attenuated tRNA operon (dimensionless, 0–1)
symbols.NTP: ribonucleoside triphosphate consumed per elongation step (count)
symbols.PPi: inorganic pyrophosphate released during elongation, net of transcript-initiating nucleotides that retain their 5′ triphosphate (count)
symbols.charged_tRNA: absolute charged (aminoacylated) tRNA concentration passed directly to the attenuation stop-probability function f (mol/L)

assumptions: NTP pools are allocated across all active RNAPs by the polymerize algorithm to maximize total elongation subject to the available-NTP reaction limit.
An RNAP terminates exactly when its transcript_length reaches the annotated TU length.
Partial mRNAs are already functional and are kept as unique molecules; completed non-mRNA transcripts become bulk molecules.

tRNA attenuation is optional; when enabled, RNAPs stochastically terminate early with per-operon probability f([charged_tRNA]) — the fitted function of absolute charged-tRNA concentration, not a charged/total ratio — and their partial transcripts are discarded.
RNAP coordinates wrap at the replichore boundaries (origin/terminus).

ecoli-chromosome-structure.doc:
Chromosome Structure — resolve fork collisions, replicate promoters, repartition segments.

1. Collision: fork passing a bound molecule either removes it (fork wins) or stalls (molecule wins).
2. Promoter replication: duplicate promoter when  pos_prev < c ≤ pos_new  (TF state + mass preserved).
3. Segment supercoiling: linking number  Lk = Tw + Wr;  on split, Lk partitioned ∝ new segment lengths.
4. Recycling: collided RNAPs/ribosomes removed; RNA transcripts + subunits returned to bulk (mass conserved).
  c: promoter coordinate; pos_prev/pos_new: fork position before/after step; Tw: twist; Wr: writhe.

_contract.summary: Reconcile the chromosome's structural state with replication-fork motion: resolve fork/bound-molecule collisions (removing and recycling passed RNAPs, RNAs and ribosomes) and duplicate promoters, genes and DnaA boxes onto the two daughter domains as each fork passes them.
_contract.description:
1. Collision: fork passing a bound molecule either removes it (fork wins) or stalls (molecule wins).
4. Recycling: collided RNAPs/ribosomes removed; RNA transcripts + subunits returned to bulk (mass conserved).
c: promoter coordinate; pos_prev/pos_new: fork position before/after step; Tw: twist; Wr: writhe.

inputs.bulk: Reads bulk ids once to resolve indices for every species this step recycles (inactive RNAPs, mature RNAs, fragment bases, PPi, 30S/50S subunits, amino acids, water, active TFs, DnaA-ATP/ADP).
inputs.active_replisomes: Reads each fork's domain_index and coordinates to decide which bound molecules the forks have passed (the removal window per domain).
inputs.chromosome_domains: Reads domain_index and child_domains to detect finished domains and to map a passed motif onto its two child domains.
inputs.active_RNAPs: Reads domain_index, coordinates, is_forward and unique_index to flag RNAPs the forks passed and classify head-on vs co-directional collisions.
inputs.RNAs: Reads TU_index, transcript_length, RNAP_index, is_full_transcript and unique_index to find transcripts of collided RNAPs and size the returned fragment bases/PPi/mature RNAs.
inputs.active_ribosome: Reads protein_index, peptide_length and mRNA_index to find ribosomes left on removed or degraded mRNAs and size the returned amino acids/water.
inputs.full_chromosomes: Reads full-chromosome domain_index to identify domains that finished replication (so all molecules on them are cleared).
inputs.promoters: Reads TU_index, domain_index, coordinates and bound_TF to select passed promoters for duplication and to free their bound TFs.
inputs.genes: Reads cistron_index, domain_index and coordinates to select passed genes for duplication.
inputs.DnaA_boxes: Reads domain_index, coordinates, DnaA_bound, pool_label and DnaA_bound_form to select passed boxes for duplication and to release any DnaA bound on them.
inputs.global_time: Reads simulation time to gate the step (update_condition) and set the next update time.
inputs.timestep: Reads the step length used to schedule next_update_time.
inputs.next_update_time: Reads the scheduled update time; the step runs only when it has arrived.

outputs.bulk: Returns recycled species to the pool: inactive RNAPs and ribosomal 30S/50S subunits, fragment bases + PPi + mature RNAs from incomplete transcripts, amino acids + water from incomplete peptides, freed active TFs, and freed DnaA-ATP/ADP from fork-crossed boxes.
outputs.listeners: Writes rnap_data collision statistics: n_total/head-on/co-directional collisions and their coordinates, incomplete_transcription_event per TU, and n_removed_ribosomes.
outputs.active_RNAPs: Deletes RNAPs that collided with a passing fork.
outputs.RNAs: Deletes transcripts whose RNAP was removed by a collision.
outputs.active_ribosome: Deletes ribosomes bound to mRNAs that no longer exist.
outputs.promoters: Deletes each passed promoter and adds two daughter copies (one per child domain) with TF binding reset.
outputs.genes: Deletes each passed gene and adds two daughter copies on the child domains.
outputs.DnaA_boxes: Deletes each passed DnaA box and adds two daughter copies (pool_label propagated, DnaA_bound_form reset to 0).
outputs.next_update_time: Writes the next scheduled update time (global_time + timestep).

config.active_tfs: Bulk ids of active TFs freed to the pool when a bound promoter is replicated.
config.inactive_RNAPs: Bulk id(s) for inactive RNAP the collided RNAPs are returned to.
config.ribosome_30S_subunit: Bulk id of the 30S subunit returned per removed ribosome.
config.ribosome_50S_subunit: Bulk id of the 50S subunit returned per removed ribosome.
config.amino_acids: Bulk ids of amino acids returned from incomplete polypeptides.
config.water: Bulk id of water consumed/released when hydrolyzing incomplete peptides.
config.fragmentBases: Bulk ids of the NTP fragment bases returned from incomplete transcripts.
config.ppi: Bulk id of pyrophosphate returned per initiated-but-incomplete transcript.
config.rna_sequences: RNA template sequences used to reconstruct incomplete-transcript base composition.
config.protein_sequences: Protein template sequences used to reconstruct incomplete-peptide amino-acid composition.
config.rna_ids: RNA identifiers indexing the transcript arrays.
config.mature_rna_ids: Bulk ids of mature RNAs that can be released when an unprocessed transcript is long enough.
config.mature_rna_end_positions: Per-mature-RNA end coordinates that decide which mature RNAs a truncated transcript yields.
config.mature_rna_nt_counts: Per-mature-RNA nucleotide counts subtracted from returned fragment bases.
config.unprocessed_rna_index_mapping: Maps unprocessed-RNA TU indices to their mature-RNA layout.
config.n_TUs: Number of transcription units (sizes the incomplete-transcription-event listener).
config.n_TFs: Number of transcription factors (width of promoter bound_TF).
config.replichore_lengths: Replichore lengths defining the min/max chromosomal coordinates.
config.relaxed_DNA_base_pairs_per_turn: Relaxed DNA helical repeat used in the supercoiling/linking-number calculation.
config.terC_index: Sentinel molecule index marking the replication terminus in segment bookkeeping.
config.no_child_place_holder: Sentinel domain index marking a chromosome domain with no children yet.

math: 2. Promoter replication: duplicate promoter when  pos_prev < c ≤ pos_new  (TF state + mass preserved).
3. Segment supercoiling: linking number  Lk = Tw + Wr;  on split, Lk partitioned ∝ new segment lengths.

symbols.c: genomic coordinate of a promoter/gene/DnaA box (nt from origin)
symbols.pos_prev: fork position at the previous step (nt)
symbols.pos_new: fork position after this step (nt); a motif is passed when pos_prev < c ≤ pos_new
symbols.Lk: linking number of a chromosomal segment (dimensionless)
symbols.Tw: twist component of the linking number (dimensionless)
symbols.Wr: writhe component of the linking number (dimensionless)

assumptions: In this build the fork always wins a collision: every bound molecule the fork passes is removed and recycled; head-on vs co-directional is recorded for listeners only, not differentiated in outcome (no fork stalling).
A molecule is 'passed' when it lies within the fork coordinate window of its domain, or on any domain whose children are already full chromosomes (replication finished).
Passed promoters, genes and DnaA boxes are duplicated onto both child domains; daughter promoters/DnaA boxes reset their binding state and their bound TFs/DnaA are released to bulk (mass conserved).
Incomplete transcripts return their NTs as fragment bases plus one PPi each, excluding any bases/PPi belonging to mature RNAs released from the truncation.
Ribosomes on removed or degraded mRNAs are dropped; their partial peptides are hydrolyzed back to free amino acids and water.

The chromosomal-segment / supercoiling repartition math (Lk = Tw + Wr) is implemented in _compute_new_segment_attributes but is not invoked by update() in this version, so the chromosomal_segments and oriCs ports are read-through only and left out of this contract's ports.
references: Katayama (2017) — DnaA dissociation from DnaA boxes after replication-fork passage.

ecoli-metabolism.doc:
Metabolism — flux-balance analysis (FBA).

Each timestep solve for the reaction flux vector v:
    max cᵀv   s.t.  S·v = 0,   v_lb ≤ v ≤ v_ub
  S: stoichiometry (metabolites×reactions); c: biomass objective;
  bounds from nutrient uptake, enzyme kcat capacity, NGAM maintenance.
The FBA returns per-metabolite concentration changes Δc (mmol/L, the
output_molecule_changes). Flux→counts uses counts_to_molar = 1/(N_A·V_cell)
(the mM-per-count factor); its inverse maps Δc back to a count change:
    Δn = stochasticRound(n₀ + Δc/counts_to_molar) − n₀   (zero-floored),
  i.e. Δc·N_A·V_cell counts added to the initial count n₀. Exchange
  fluxes are reported on a gDCW basis via κ = m_dry/m_cell·density·dt.
Optional ppGpp growth coupling and kinetic (kcat) flux constraints.

_contract.summary: Flux-balance analysis (FBA): each step maximize the biomass objective subject to steady-state mass balance and flux bounds from nutrient uptake, enzyme kcat capacity, and NGAM maintenance; convert the resulting fluxes to bulk molecule-count changes. Runs deriver-like after all other processes (not partitioned).

inputs.bulk_total: Reads total (pre-partition) amino-acid counts to update tRNA-charging concentration targets.
inputs.listeners: Reads mass.cell_mass/dry_mass (cell volume, counts_to_molar, flux↔conc coefficient κ) and rna_mass/protein_mass (RNA:protein ratio for biomass targets); writes fba_results, enzyme_kinetics, and fba_bridge diagnostics.
inputs.environment: Reads media_id and exchange_data (constrained max uptake rates + unconstrained importers) to set external molecule availability for the LP.
inputs.boundary: Reads external[aa] concentrations to decide which amino acids are present in the media (mechanistic AA-transport gating).
inputs.polypeptide_elongation: Reads gtp_to_hydrolyze (translation GTP maintenance flux), aa_count_diff (AA supply/consumption for target updates), and aa_exchange_rates (mechanistic AA uptake rates).
inputs.pinned_flux_targets: Reads {fba_reaction_id: flux} hard pins from the Millard-ODE coupler; pins those bounds before the solve and relaxes any pin that makes the LP infeasible.
inputs.global_time: Clock read used to gate the update and stamp next_update_time.

outputs.bulk: Writes stochastically-rounded, zero-floored Δmetabolite counts from the FBA output_molecule_changes.
outputs.environment: Writes exchange = per-nutrient molecule-count delta exchanged with the environment store.
outputs.listeners: Writes fba_results (objective value, reaction/exchange fluxes, shadow prices, reduced costs, conc/target updates), enzyme_kinetics (actual/target fluxes, counts_to_molar), and fba_bridge.relaxed_reactions.
outputs.next_update_time: Writes global_time + timestep for the next scheduled solve.

config.mechanistic_aa_transport: If True, apply mechanistic amino-acid uptake constraints from elongation aa_exchange_rates.
config.use_trna_charging: If True, update amino-acid concentration targets from tRNA-charging supply/demand each step.
config.ngam: Non-growth-associated maintenance ATP flux (mmol/g/h), pinned as the maintenance reaction bound.
config.dark_atp: Growth-associated maintenance ATP (mmol/g); GAM = dark_atp × cell_dry_mass_fraction.
config.cell_dry_mass_fraction: Dry fraction of cell mass; multiplies dark_atp to give the GAM maintenance cost.
config.cell_density: Cell density (g/L); cell volume = cell_mass/density → counts_to_molar and the flux↔conc coefficient.
config.doubling_time: Baseline doubling time setting the initial biomass concentration targets.
config.nutrientToDoublingTime: Map media_id → doubling time, selecting media-specific biomass concentration targets.
config.import_constraint_threshold: External concentration above which a nutrient is treated as available for uptake.
config.removed_aa_uptake: Amino acids whose environmental uptake is disabled.
config.media_id: Default media id used when the environment media is unmapped.
config.base_reaction_ids: Base (lumped) reaction ids; the FBA→base mapping aggregates split/reverse fluxes for reporting.
config.fba_reaction_ids_to_base_reaction_ids: Map each FBA reaction (incl. reverse) to its base reaction, with sign, for base_reaction_fluxes.

symbols.c: FBA objective coefficients — biomass production weights (dimensionless)
symbols.v: reaction flux vector solved by the LP (mmol/g_DCW/h)
symbols.v_lb: lower flux bounds (mmol/g_DCW/h): uptake, kcat capacity, NGAM maintenance
symbols.\u0394n: per-metabolite molecule-count change applied to bulk this step (count)
symbols.\u0394c: FBA per-metabolite concentration change this step (output_molecule_changes, mmol/L)
symbols.n\u2080: initial per-metabolite count before the step, from bulk (count)
symbols.counts_to_molar: count→concentration factor = 1/(N_A·V_cell) (mM per count); its inverse (N_A·V_cell) converts Δc to a count change
symbols.m_dry: cell dry mass, from listeners.mass.dry_mass (g); feeds the exchange-flux coefficient κ
symbols.\u03ba: exchange flux↔gDCW-basis coefficient = m_dry/m_cell·density·dt (g·s/L); used for exchange-flux reporting and the NGAM bound, NOT the metabolite count conversion
symbols.NGAM: non-growth-associated maintenance ATP flux, pinned as a bound (mmol/g/h)
symbols.ppGpp: guanosine tetraphosphate; when include_ppgpp, an objective target coupling regulation to growth (mM)

assumptions: Steady-state mass balance (S·v = 0) is imposed each timestep: metabolite pools are quasi-steady relative to dt.
Runs deriver-like after all other processes update internal state; not partitioned (no request/allocate arbitration).

The FBA returns per-metabolite concentration changes (mmol/L); these are converted to counts via counts_to_molar = 1/(N_A·V_cell), then stochastically rounded and floored at zero. Exchange fluxes use the separate κ = m_dry/m_cell·density·dt gDCW-basis coefficient.
Enzyme capacity is modeled by catalyst presence: a reaction with no catalyst present gets an upper flux bound of zero.
Amino-acid uptake is capped to the homeostatic concentration need to prevent AAs acting as an unbounded carbon/nitrogen source.
Objective is homeostatic, or mixed homeostatic+kinetic when kcat constraints are enabled (kinetic_objective_weight > 0).
references: Homeostatic + kinetic mixed FBA objective, Covert lab E. coli whole-cell model

counts_deriver.doc: Tallies molecule counts for downstream readouts: mRNA/rRNA transcription-unit and cistron counts (partial + full transcripts), protein monomer counts (including monomers sequestered in complexes and in active ribosomes/RNAPs/replisomes), and per-type active unique-molecule totals. Consolidates the former RNACounts, MonomerCounts, and UniqueMoleculeCounts listeners into one step.

_contract.summary: Count-observable deriver: tallies mRNA/rRNA transcription-unit and cistron counts (partial vs full transcripts), protein monomer counts (decomposing bulk complexes and folding in subunits sequestered in active ribosomes/RNAPs/replisomes and promoter-bound TFs), and per-type active unique-molecule totals. Pure read-out.

inputs.RNAs: Reads unique RNA TU_index, can_translate, and is_full_transcript to tally mRNA/rRNA transcription-unit and cistron counts (partial vs full transcripts).
inputs.bulk: Reads bulk molecule counts, then decomposes complexes (TCS → equilibrium → complexation) to recover protein monomer totals.
inputs.unique: Reads active_ribosome/active_RNAP/active_replisome _entryState to fold sequestered subunits into monomer totals and to report per-type active counts.
inputs.promoters: Reads bound_TF to fold promoter-bound transcription-factor subunits back into monomer totals.
inputs.global_time: Clock read used with timestep to gate the update cadence.
inputs.timestep: Update cadence divisor (update runs when global_time % timestep == 0).

outputs.listeners: Writes rna_counts (mRNA/rRNA TU and cistron counts, partial/full), monomer_counts (overwrite/SET semantics), and unique_molecule_counts (per-type active totals).

config.cistron_tu_mapping_matrix: Cistron × transcription-unit matrix M_cistron_TU mapping TU counts to cistron counts.
config.complexation_stoich: Complexation stoichiometry S_cplx; unpacks bulk complexes into constituent monomers.
config.equilibrium_stoich: Equilibrium-binding stoichiometry S_eq; unpacks equilibrium complexes.
config.two_component_system_stoich: Two-component-system stoichiometry S_tcs; unpacks phosphotransfer complexes.
config.monomer_ids: Protein monomer species whose final counts are reported.
config.unique_ids: Unique-molecule types whose active _entryState totals are reported.
config.tf_ids: Transcription-factor subunit ids folded back into monomer totals from promoter-bound TFs.
config.ribosome_50s_subunits: 50S ribosomal subunit ids + stoichiometry for active-ribosome subunit accounting.
config.ribosome_30s_subunits: 30S ribosomal subunit ids + stoichiometry for active-ribosome subunit accounting.
config.rnap_subunits: RNA-polymerase subunit ids + stoichiometry for active-RNAP subunit accounting.

math: n_monomer = bulk_free + S_cplx·(-n_complex) + S_eq·(-n_eqcplx) + S_tcs·(-n_tcs) + subunits(active ribosome/RNAP/replisome + bound_TF)
TU_counts = bincount(RNA.TU_index over translatable + rRNA);  cistron_counts = M_cistron_TU · TU_counts;  partial = all - full
unique_type_count = sum(_entryState) per unique-molecule type

symbols.n_monomer: protein monomer counts, including monomers sequestered in complexes and active machinery (count)
symbols.bulk_free: free bulk molecule counts before complex decomposition (count)
symbols.S_cplx: complexation stoichiometry (molecules × complexes); unpacks bulk complexes into constituent monomers
symbols.n_complex: counts of bulk complexation complexes being decomposed (count)
symbols.S_eq: equilibrium-binding stoichiometry; unpacks equilibrium complexes into monomers
symbols.S_tcs: two-component-system stoichiometry; unpacks phosphotransfer complexes into monomers
symbols.TU_counts: per-transcription-unit RNA counts from bincount over unique RNA TU_index (count)
symbols._entryState: per-row active flag of a unique-molecule array; summed to count active molecules of a type

assumptions: Pure derivation/read-out: it does not mutate bulk/unique state; monomer_counts uses overwrite (SET) semantics to avoid step-wise accumulation.
Complexes are decomposed in order TCS → equilibrium → complexation (nested subunits) after adding active-machinery and bound-TF subunits, so nested complexes fully resolve to monomers.
Consolidates the former RNACounts, MonomerCounts, and UniqueMoleculeCounts listeners; verified byte-identical to the pre-consolidation baseline.

emitter.doc:
Generic Parquet emitter, hive-partitioned per ``partitioning_keys``.

The process-bigraph lifecycle drives the emit cadence:

  - configuration is written at ``__init__`` time from ``config["metadata"]``
    (only when ``metadata`` is non-None);
  - history rows arrive via ``update(state)`` per composite tick;
  - ``close(success=...)`` flushes the buffer and (when ``success=True``
    and a partitioning layout is configured) writes the success sentinel.

Durability-sensitive callers must call ``close()`` explicitly at end of
composite run; ``__del__`` calls it defensively but interpreter-shutdown
ordering is undefined.

_contract.summary: Raise the division flag once the D period has elapsed after chromosome replication completes: when global_time reaches the earliest untriggered chromosome division_time, mark that chromosome triggered and set divide=True.

inputs.full_chromosome: Reads division_time and has_triggered_division; selects the earliest untriggered division_time and marks it triggered.
inputs.global_time: Compared against the earliest untriggered division_time to decide whether to fire.
inputs.divide: Downstream division flag, set True when the D-period deadline is reached.

outputs.full_chromosome: Writes the updated has_triggered_division array (the fired chromosome marked True).
outputs.divide: Writes True when the earliest untriggered chromosome's division_time has been reached.

math: divide := True  and  has_triggered_division[k] := True   when  t_global ≥ min(division_time[¬has_triggered])

symbols.division_time: per-chromosome scheduled division time = replication completion + D period (s)

assumptions: division_time is scheduled at replication completion + D_period.

division.doc:
Detect division and produce daughter cells via _add/_remove.

When the division condition is met (dry mass >= threshold with 2+
chromosomes), this step:
1. Divides the mother cell's state (bulk binomial, unique by domain)
2. Builds complete daughter cell states with fresh process instances
3. Returns structural update to remove mother and add daughters

_contract.summary: Detect the division condition and split the mother cell into two daughters via process-bigraph _add/_remove structural updates: bulk molecules split binomially, unique molecules partitioned by chromosome domain, daughter composites rebuilt from baseline().

inputs.listeners: Reads mass.dry_mass to evaluate the division trigger (legacy mass threshold) and to seed daughter mass listeners.
inputs.unique: Reads full_chromosome _entryState for the n_chrom ≥ 2 gate; the whole unique tree is partitioned by chromosome domain into the two daughters.
inputs.divide: Reads the D-period flag; under d_period (default) division fires when this is set and n_chrom ≥ 2.
inputs.division_threshold: Reads the dry-mass threshold on the legacy path; initialized on first step from media-specific increment × μ_div.
inputs.bulk: Reads the mother's bulk state, split binomially into the two daughters.
inputs.environment: Reads the mother's environment state, carried into both daughter cell states.
inputs.boundary: Reads the mother's boundary state, carried into both daughter cell states.
inputs.media_id: Selects the media-specific dry-mass increment for the legacy threshold initialization.
inputs.global_time: Read as the division timestamp stamped onto both daughters.

outputs.agents: Writes a structural update: _remove the mother agent and _add two rebuilt daughter cell composites (fresh process instances + divided biological state).
outputs.division_threshold: Writes the computed dry-mass division threshold on the legacy (mass_distribution) path.

math: d_period (default): divide  iff  divide_flag ∧ n_chrom ≥ 2   (dry-mass threshold ignored)
legacy: divide  iff  m_dry ≥ threshold ∧ n_chrom ≥ 2
threshold = m_dry,0 + Δm_dry · μ_div,   μ_div ~ Normal(1.0, 0.1)
on trigger: bulk ~ Binomial(n, ½) split;  unique partitioned by chromosome domain → daughters (d0,d1) via _add/_remove

symbols.n_chrom: number of full chromosomes (Σ _entryState); division requires ≥ 2
symbols.threshold: dry-mass division threshold (fg); consulted only on the legacy path
symbols.\u0394m_dry: media-specific dry-mass increment added per generation (fg)
symbols.divide_flag: D-period flag raised by MarkDPeriod at the chromosome's division_time
symbols.n: molecule copy count of a bulk species, split ~ Binomial(n, ½) between daughters

assumptions: Under d_period=True (vEcoli default) division fires D-period after replication completes (via the divide flag), and the dry-mass threshold is ignored; otherwise the legacy mass-distribution threshold is used.
Division requires at least two full chromosomes.
Bulk molecules split binomially (p=0.5); unique molecules are partitioned by chromosome domain.
The division mass multiplier μ_div is drawn once from Normal(1.0, 0.1) (CRC32-seeded) for the mass_distribution threshold.
Daughters are rebuilt via baseline() with the divided biological state overlaid; the parquet emitter is re-pointed per daughter to avoid clobbering the parent's history.
